extracted.intended_audience: journalists, newsroom staff, digital reporters, fact-checkers, and news organizations
extracted.subtask_description: A hub of resources and lessons for newsrooms to strengthen digital reporting, storytelling, verification, audience development, and revenue strategies using Google products and other digital tools.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use digital tools to find, verify, and tell engaging stories
rubrics_metrics.description: Use digital tools and resources that can help you find, verify, and tell engaging stories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: High-level objective of the page; underpins lessons and case studies across the site (e.g., Google Trends for story discovery, Reverse Image Search for verification, Pinpoint for document analysis).

rubrics_metrics.name: Develop your digital reporting skills
rubrics_metrics.description: Use tools and resources to help you find, verify, and tell engaging stories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Section header grouping practical training (examples on this page include Google News Archive, Google Trends, Reverse Image Search, Access Google Finance data in Sheets, Fundamentals course).

rubrics_metrics.name: Explore new storytelling formats
rubrics_metrics.description: Experiment with new ways to visualize stories using new content formats, data, and more.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourages journalists to experiment with visualizations, interactive formats, video, apps and data-driven storytelling (examples: Data Studio, Google Earth Studio, YouTube Creator Academy, Data Journalism course, Google Sheets scraping).

rubrics_metrics.name: Find new ways to fight misinformation
rubrics_metrics.description: Explore digital tools that help verify the authenticity and accuracy of online images, videos and reports.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focuses on verification workflows and fact-checking tools (examples: Google Fact Check Tools, Video: Google tools for fact-checkers, Verification course, ClaimReview markup).

rubrics_metrics.name: Google News Archive: historical research
rubrics_metrics.description: Discover historical digital publications and scanned newspapers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use archives to access past publications and scanned newspapers as primary/secondary sources for reporting and context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Google Trends for story discovery
rubrics_metrics.description: See what’s trending across Google Search, Google News and YouTube; find stories and terms people are paying attention to.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use Trends to identify topics, rising queries and audience interest; additional lesson 'Understanding the data' covers how to interpret Trends results.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interpret Trends data correctly
rubrics_metrics.description: How to interpret Trends results.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page offers a dedicated lesson explaining how to read and make sense of Google Trends outputs, implying importance of data literacy when using Trends.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reverse Image Search for photo verification
rubrics_metrics.description: Find photographs and uncover their backstories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use reverse image search techniques/tools to verify provenance, identify previous uses of an image, and trace metadata/backstory.

rubrics_metrics.name: Access Google Finance data in Sheets
rubrics_metrics.description: Access Google Finance data in Google Sheets. Examine closing prices, percentage change or market movement over any timeframe.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use Sheets integration to pull financial data for reporting, analysis and visualizations; supports routine financial journalism and data-backed stories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use Pinpoint and document-analysis tools
rubrics_metrics.description: Upload and analyze large numbers of documents with the power of Google Search, AI, and machine learning (Pinpoint).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tools like Pinpoint can speed transcription, enable smarter data extraction and support AI-powered storytelling; illustrated by case studies of newsroom usage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Harness AI to streamline ground reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Use AI-powered transcription, smarter data extraction, and AI-powered storytelling to streamline newsroom workflows.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Case studies (e.g., 'Harnessing AI for Journalism' and 'Palawan News') demonstrate practical productivity gains and use-cases (faster transcriptions, automated scriptwriting/image generation for video).

rubrics_metrics.name: Build datasets using Google Sheets (web scraping)
rubrics_metrics.description: Build your own data sets using Google Sheets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lesson on scraping data from the internet into Sheets to create reporters' datasets for analysis, visualization and story-building.

rubrics_metrics.name: Improve video and platform skills (YouTube Creator Academy)
rubrics_metrics.description: Learn how to access and choose lessons that help strengthen your YouTube presence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Platform-specific training to help journalists produce and optimize video content for audience growth and engagement on YouTube.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use Google Earth Studio for animated geography visuals
rubrics_metrics.description: A fully functional animation studio for Google Earth imagery.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Create animated maps and geospatial visuals to show 'where stories happen' and add visual context to reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Create interactive data visualizations (Data Studio)
rubrics_metrics.description: Give life to your datasets by creating powerful interactive visualizations with an easy-to-use studio.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use Data Studio to build interactive charts, dashboards and visual stories that let audiences explore data themselves.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strengthen data journalism skills
rubrics_metrics.description: From beginner to advanced, strengthen your ability to analyze and interpret data with Google Trends and a range of tools from Google and beyond.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Structured course pathway for reporters to move from basics to advanced data-driven reporting techniques and tool use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use Public Data Explorer for high-quality datasets
rubrics_metrics.description: Use high-quality data sets to create compelling visuals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tap curated public datasets to support reporting, provide context and power visualizations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Verification training: verify images, videos and reports
rubrics_metrics.description: Explore time-saving methods and digital tools to help verify the authenticity and accuracy of images, videos and reports found on social media and across the web.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Course and lessons provide practical verification workflows, tools and heuristics for rapid and reliable fact-checking.

rubrics_metrics.name: Google Fact Check Tools and ClaimReview
rubrics_metrics.description: These tools allow you to search for stories and images that have already been debunked and lets you add ClaimReview markup to your own fact checks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Search existing fact checks to avoid duplication and use ClaimReview to make your fact checks machine-readable and discoverable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Promote positive reader discussion and combat disinformation
rubrics_metrics.description: Use platform design and AI (e.g., in commenting platforms) to combat disinformation and promote constructive discussion.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Case study shows Delfi’s use of AI in a new user-commenting platform to reduce disinformation and improve engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Protect accounts and newsroom security
rubrics_metrics.description: Use security tools such as Password Alert and 2-Step Verification to protect yourself from password theft and add an extra layer of protection beyond your password.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Security lessons emphasize account protection as a prerequisite for safe reporting and secure newsroom operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Develop your audience with data
rubrics_metrics.description: Use data to grow and understand your audience, shape your content, and keep your visitors engaged.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Audience-development guidance centers on using analytics and data-driven strategies to inform editorial decisions and engagement tactics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grow revenue with diverse monetization
rubrics_metrics.description: Discover ways to earn more revenue from digital ads, subscriptions, memberships, and contributions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Offers strategies and resources for newsrooms to diversify income streams, optimize monetization, and sustain journalism operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use resources designed with industry experts
rubrics_metrics.description: Tools, training, and resources designed in partnership with industry experts, academics, and news organizations around the world.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes that trainings and tools are developed collaboratively and are intended to reflect newsroom needs and best practices.
